integrity: Proof invokes the standard Hasse bound and a complete 23-parameter exact finite-field table, independently reproduced by exhaustive 2300-triple checks. No unverified asymptotic or external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is only for the field of 25 elements. The minimum size 3 and Hasse threshold beyond 25 are previously established. It does not imply an infinite-family classification, and independently confirmed originality is not asserted.
title: Rigidity of three-translate quadratic-residue coverings of \(\mathbb F_{25}\)
